data: Which of the following models has the highest average score on all GLUE tasks with 10 billion tokens?

The question asks which model has the highest average score on all GLUE tasks with 10 billion tokens. From the caption, we know that the figure shows the average results for three models: MLM, NSP, and Split, across different types of tasks (all tasks, inference tasks, and non-inference tasks). The x-axis represents the number of tokens used for training (in billions), and the y-axis represents the average score on tasks.

Looking at the leftmost graph labeled 'a) All tasks', we can see the performance of the three models across all tasks. The blue line represents the MLM model, the red line represents the NSP model, and the yellow line represents the Split model. At 10 billion tokens, the blue line (MLM) is the highest among the three lines.

Therefore, the MLM model has the highest average score on all GLUE tasks with 10 billion tokens.
